items.title: Upon waking
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and to Him is the resurrection.

items.title: Morning remembrance
items.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent.

items.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u laka bi dhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant. I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi
items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi shay'im min 'ilmihi illa bi ma sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azim.
items.translation: Allah—there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

items.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas
items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
items.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, nor is there to Him any equivalent. (Recite 3 times in the morning.)

items.title: Surah Al-Falaq
items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies. (Recite 3 times in the morning.)

items.title: Surah An-Nas
items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of mankind—from among the jinn and mankind. (Recite 3 times in the morning.)

items.title: Morning protection (3x)
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing. (Recite 3 times.)

items.title: Pleasure with Allah
items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
items.transliteration: Radheetu billahi rabba, wa bil-islami dina, wa bi Muhammadin ﷺ nabiyya.
items.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet. (Recite 3 times.)

items.title: Morning with Allah
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
items.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, by You we enter the evening, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

items.title: Subhanallah wa bihamdihi (100x)
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. (Recite 100 times in the morning.)

items.title: Tawhid (100x)
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent. (Recite 100 times in the morning.)

items.title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all of my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

items.title: Hasbunallah
items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azim.
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne. (Recite 7 times.)

items.title: Evening remembrance
items.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and all praise, and He is over all things competent.

items.title: Evening with Allah
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.
items.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, by You we enter the morning, by You we live, by You we die, and to You is the final return.

items.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

items.translation: Allah—there is no god except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence...

items.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas (3x)
items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ

items.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One... (Recite 3 times in the evening.)

items.title: Surah Al-Falaq (3x)
items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak... (Recite 3 times in the evening.)

items.title: Surah An-Nas (3x)
items.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ

items.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind... (Recite 3 times in the evening.)

items.title: Evening protection (3x)
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

items.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing. (Recite 3 times.)

items.title: Pleasure with Allah
items.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا

items.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet. (Recite 3 times.)

items.title: Seeking refuge from creation
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created. (Recite 3 times in the evening.)

items.title: Subhanallah wa bihamdihi (100x)
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
items.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. (Recite 100 times in the evening.)

items.title: Well-being of body and hearing
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant.
items.translation: O Allah, grant me well-being in my body. O Allah, grant me well-being in my hearing. O Allah, grant me well-being in my sight. There is no god but You. (Recite 3 times.)

items.title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
items.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
items.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
items.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all of my affairs for me, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

items.title: Hasbunallah (7x)
items.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
items.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azim.
items.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne. (Recite 7 times.)

items.title: Before eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.

items.title: If forgetting Bismillah
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.

items.title: After eating
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

items.title: Leaving home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

items.title: Entering home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
items.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'alallahi rabbina tawakkalna.
items.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

items.title: Entering the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahummaftah li abwaba rahmatik.
items.translation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

items.title: Leaving the mosque
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.title: Entering the toilet
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah. Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith.
items.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female unclean spirits.

items.title: Leaving the toilet
items.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
items.transliteration: Ghufranak.
items.translation: I seek Your forgiveness.

items.title: Before wudu
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.

items.title: After wudu
items.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh.
items.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

items.title: When dressing
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

items.title: Looking in the mirror
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
items.transliteration: Allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fa hassin khuluqi.
items.translation: O Allah, just as You have made my outward form beautiful, make my character beautiful.

items.title: When angry
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed.

items.title: When sneezing
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
items.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah. (Reply to the sneezer: Yarhamukallah — May Allah have mercy on you. Then the sneezer says: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.)

items.title: Hearing a rooster
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
items.translation: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.title: When it rains
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a.
items.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial downpour.

items.title: When distressed
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'azimul-halim. La ilaha illallahu rabbul-'arshil-'azim. La ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul-ardi wa rabbul-'arshil-karim.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

items.title: After finishing salah
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (٣) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3x). Allahumma antas-salamu wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah (3 times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.

items.title: Tasbih after salah
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٣) لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33), Alhamdulillah (33), Allahu Akbar (33), then: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.
items.translation: Glory be to Allah (33), all praise is for Allah (33), Allah is the Greatest (33), then complete with the declaration of Tawhid once.

items.title: Before sleep
items.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
items.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
items.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

items.title: Sleeping dhikr
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣) الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣) اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
items.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33), Alhamdulillah (33), Allahu Akbar (34).
items.translation: Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, Allah is the Greatest — the bedtime tasbih taught by the Prophet ﷺ.

items.title: Ayat al-Kursi before sleep
items.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
items.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum...
items.translation: Recite Ayat al-Kursi before sleeping. Whoever does so will have a guardian from Allah over them until morning.

items.title: Last two verses of Al-Baqarah
items.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ... لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا...
items.transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi wal-mu'minun... La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha...
items.translation: Recite the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah (2:285–286). They will suffice whoever reads them at night.

items.title: Three Quls before sleep
items.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
items.transliteration: Qul huwa Allahu ahad... Qul a'udhu bi rabbil-falaq... Qul a'udhu bi rabbin-nas.
items.translation: Blow into the palms and wipe over the body after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas (three times each).

items.title: Placing trust before sleep
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Amantu bi kitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa bi nabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
items.translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affairs to You, turn my face to You, and lean my back upon You, in hope and fear of You. There is no refuge or escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.

items.title: When turning at night
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wal-ardi wa ma baynahumal-'azizul-ghaffar.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Prevailing. Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, the Almighty, the Oft-Forgiving.

items.title: If waking suddenly at night
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. Alhamdulillah, wa subhanallah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner... All praise is for Allah, glory be to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might nor power except with Allah. Then make du'a.

items.title: Dream interpretation dua
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ الرُّؤْيَا
items.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim wa min sharri hadhihir-ru'ya.
items.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the accursed, and from the evil of this dream. (Then spit lightly to the left three times and do not tell others.)

items.title: When rising for night prayer
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ...
items.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samawati wal-ardi wa man fihinn...
items.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise. You are the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them...

items.title: Before eating
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.

items.title: If forgetting Bismillah
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
items.transliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah at its beginning and end.

items.title: After eating
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power from myself.

items.title: After a meal (longer)
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda'in wa la mustaghnan 'anhu rabbana.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah — abundant, pure, and blessed praise — a praise that is never enough, never abandoned, and never dispensed with, our Lord.

items.title: When drinking milk
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa zidna minh.
items.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

items.title: When offered food while fasting
items.arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
items.transliteration: Inni sa'im.
items.translation: I am fasting.

items.title: Starting a journey
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun.
items.translation: Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done so ourselves. To our Lord we shall surely return.

items.title: Travel supplication
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda. Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safari wal-khalifatu fil-ahl.
items.translation: O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family.

items.title: Returning from travel
items.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
items.transliteration: Ayibuna ta'ibuna 'abiduna li rabbina hamidun.
items.translation: We return, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.

items.title: Entering a town
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma azlalna... as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha.
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and what they shade... I ask You for the good of this town and its people, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of its people.

items.title: When the animal/vehicle stumbles
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah.

items.title: Dweller's greeting on arrival
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا
items.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fiha.
items.translation: O Allah, bless it for us.

items.title: Visiting the sick
items.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ba's, tahurun in sha Allah.
items.translation: No harm, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

items.title: For the ill
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِهِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
items.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfihi wa antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.
items.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal him, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing — a healing that leaves behind no illness.

items.title: When in pain
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (٣) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (٧)
items.transliteration: Bismillah (3x). A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (7x).
items.translation: In the name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear (7 times), placing the hand on the place of pain.

items.title: Ruqyah for illness
items.arabic: أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شَافِيَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Adhhibil-ba'sa rabban-nas, ishfi antash-shafi, la shafiya illa ant.
items.translation: Remove the harm, O Lord of mankind. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healer but You.

items.title: When visiting a Muslim who is ill
items.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
items.transliteration: As'alullahal-'azima rabbal-'arshil-'azimi an yashfiyak.
items.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Mighty Throne, to heal you. (Recite 7 times.)

items.title: At the time of death
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illallah.
items.translation: There is no god but Allah. (Encourage the dying to say this.)

items.title: Seeking refuge
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

items.title: Protection from anxiety
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
items.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal.
items.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.

items.title: Protection when leaving home
items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
items.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

items.title: Against the evil eye
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammah min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

items.title: Dua of Yunus
items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.
items.translation: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

items.title: When afraid
items.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
items.transliteration: A'udhu bi kalimatillahit-tammati min ghadabihi wa 'iqabih, wa sharri 'ibadih, wa min hamazatish-shayatin wa an yahdurun.
items.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His servants, and from the whisperings of the devils and from their presence.

items.title: Protection of children
items.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
items.transliteration: U'idhukumā bi kalimatillahit-tammah min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.
items.translation: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every evil eye.

items.title: When seeing something afflict someone
items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi 'afani mimmabtalaka bih, wa faddalani 'ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdila.
items.translation: All praise is for Allah who spared me from what He has afflicted you with, and who favored me greatly over many of those He created. (Say quietly, not aloud to hurt the person.)

items.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
items.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk...
items.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. None has the right to be worshipped except You... so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

items.title: Seeking forgiveness
items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-tawwabur-raheem.
items.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. You are the Acceptor of repentance, the Most Merciful.

items.title: Astaghfirullah
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullah.
items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah.

items.title: Istighfar of the Prophet
items.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
items.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha alladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyuma wa atubu ilayh.
items.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, besides whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

items.title: Dua of Adam
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
items.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

items.title: Comprehensive forgiveness
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrah.
items.translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sin — the small and the great, the first and the last, the open and the secret.

items.title: Best istighfar in gathering
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
items.transliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk.
items.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You. (Said at the end of a gathering.)

items.title: For parents
items.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera.
items.translation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they raised me when I was small.

items.title: For believing parents
items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana ghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
items.translation: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents, and the believers on the Day the account is established.

items.title: Forgiveness for parents
items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.
items.translation: My Lord, forgive me, my parents, whoever enters my house as a believer, and the believing men and believing women.

items.title: Kindness after parents pass
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Allahummaghfir li wa liwalidayya warhamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera.
items.translation: O Allah, forgive me and my parents, and have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.

items.title: Goodness to parents
items.arabic: وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ إِحْسَانًا
items.transliteration: Wa qada rabbuka alla ta'budu illa iyyahu wa bil-walidayni ihsana.
items.translation: Your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and that you be kind to parents.
